tryIt.sentence: Um, so this weekend we're going hiking, we leave Saturday at seven, no wait, at eight in the morning. Everyone should bring three things, first water, second sunscreen, and third, uh, a jacket. It gets windy up there, so we'll have lunch at the top, head down before four, and get dinner together in the evening.
tryIt.hold: Hold {{hotkey}}, read it aloud, then release
tryIt.toggle: Press {{hotkey}}, read it aloud, then press it again
tryIt.noPolish: No polished text. With a polish model set, filler words and slips are removed here and lists are laid out.
tryIt.voiceSample: This reading stays on this computer and is used to recognize your voice.
tryIt.longPassage: So, um, about the move, like, we're moving to the new place next month, and I asked two movers, one quoted three thousand and the other twenty-five hundred, but the cheaper one isn't free until the end of the month, um, so I wanted to ask everyone, would you rather pay five hundred more and move early, or wait until the end of the month, oh, and also the books need to be boxed up before Saturday, that one is urgent.
tryIt.rewriteDraft: can't make dinner tomorrow, something came up at home, you guys go ahead, next one's on me
tryIt.rewriteHint: The sentence above is selected. With {{hotkey}}, say "make it more polite" or "translate it into Spanish"
tryIt.nameHint: Say “{{name}}” first and the rest is an instruction. “{{name}}, translate that into French” changes the text just entered. Leave it empty to keep this off
